alt: Line chart of net savings against the flagging threshold on a log scale. Savings start at about minus ₹18L for very low thresholds, cross zero near 0.8%, peak at ₹10.81L near 2.4%, then fall. A dashed line marks the three-band policy at ₹11.99L.
caption: With a single flag-or-allow threshold, savings peak at ₹10.81L; flagging anything above about 0.8% risk or less loses money. The three-band policy beats the best single threshold, at ₹11.99L.
